mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring any specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is stable or declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, which initially depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction term has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high residential construction activity (HOUST above 1300 thousand units) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and rising interest rates, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 5% signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST YoY > 5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
